review_candidates.description: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Monitoring, Evaluation, Technology, Accountability, and Learning at the IRC The METAL Unit is responsible for supporting CRRD to have a culture of strong data and evidence use through stewardship of the Data & Performance Ecosystem, and for coordinating successful piloting and uptake of innovative technology solutions. The METAL Unit provides specialized support across four pillars to strengthen program effectiveness, improve decision-making, and enhance organizational learning: Global MEAL Practice, Technology for Programs, Regional MEAL Support, and CRRD Data & Analytics. Job Overview The Software Developer will be part of the METAL team which is responsible for delivering products that support the collection, management and visualization of KPIs relevant to higher-level decision-making for CRRD Programs. The Software Developer will build and support data tools that drive decision-making across IRC, working with platforms like PowerApps, Power BI, Databricks, and Azure SQL. They will be a skilled contributor to the CRRD Data & Analytics team with strong experience in Microsoft PowerApps and Power Automate. Strong in team development processes including pair programming, shadow sessions, code reviews and other strategies to ensure high quality programing. Ability to effectively communicate in English both in verbal (i.e., day-to-day discussions, team meetings) and written (requirements and design specifications) form, as well as an overall ability to be clear and concise in all communications. Strong analytic curiosity and innovative problem-solving skills using a system thinking approach. Demonstrable ability to work both independently and in a dynamic, cross-functional team structure. Demonstrable ability to establish and maintain working relationships across all departments and levels of the organization. Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related discipline Experience with Databricks, Dataverse connectors, APIs, and Microsoft Azure Certifications such Microsoft Power Platform Developer are an added advantage Compensation: (US Pay Rate: $85,000 - $95,000/yr; UK Pay Rate: £46,780 - £55,552/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. The role involves designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data platforms that process and analyze human-generated datasets. The position requires expertise in handling large-scale data infrastructure while ensuring performance, reliability, and security. Key Responsibilities: • Design, build, and optimize data pipelines to process human-generated datasets at scale. • Develop and maintain backend services that support real-time and batch data processing. • Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to ensure data integrity and accessibility. • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to maintain platform reliability. • Contribute to architectural decisions that enhance scalability and performance of data systems. Required Skills & Qualifications: • Proficiency in Python, Java, or Go for backend development. • Experience with distributed systems, including Kafka, Spark, or similar technologies. • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure for data infrastructure. • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases for data storage and retrieval. • Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance best practices. • Ability to design and optimize data pipelines for performance and scalability. • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes. • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in debugging complex systems. More About the Opportunity: This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Software Development | Technology, Information and Internet | Data Infrastructure and Analytics industry, contributing to the development of robust data platforms that power critical business decisions. The position involves solving complex technical challenges in a collaborative, distributed team environment. Equal Opportunity Employer: We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications. Apply Now!

Fluent in English: Proficient in both written and spoken English. --------------------- Email: thuy.ha@helius-tech.com Hotline: 0969.20.30.42
